definition: A consortium of international type 1 diabetes family and case-control collections, organised through Asia-Pacific, European, North American and United Kingdom networks to identify genetic determinants of diabetes susceptibility and provide shared biological samples and data.
quote: The initial goal was to collect 2500 affected sibling pair (ASP) families worldwide.
remark: Proposed type change: cohort -> cohort aggregation. The consortium coordinates regional networks and distinct affected-sibling, trio and case-control collections.

label: UK Adult Twin Register
definition: A registry of volunteer adult twins from across the United Kingdom, established in 1992, with repeated clinical assessments, questionnaires and molecular data to investigate genetic and environmental contributions to ageing and complex disease.
quote: started in 1992 and encompasses about 12000 volunteer twins from all over the United Kingdom.
remark: Proposed type change: cohort aggregation -> cohort. TwinsUK is a participant registry with longitudinal follow-up.

label: UK Biobank
definition: A cohort of adults aged 40–69 recruited across the United Kingdom in 2006–2010, with biological samples, extensive phenotyping and prospective health follow-up, established to investigate genetic and nongenetic determinants of diseases of middle and older age.
quote: over 500,000 participants aged 40–69 years when recruited in 2006–2010

label: UK Brain Expression Consortium
definition: A consortium of brain-tissue collections from neuropathologically normal donors in Edinburgh, United Kingdom, and the United States, combining genotypes and expression measurements across brain regions to investigate genetic regulation of brain gene expression.
quote: All individuals were confirmed to be neuropathologically normal by a consultant neuropathologist
remark: Proposed type change: cohort -> cohort aggregation. The official methods combine material from two independent brain banks.

label: UK Childhood Cancer Study
definition: A case-control collection of children with cancer and controls matched by sex, age and residence throughout England, Scotland and Wales during 1991–1998, assembled to investigate causes of childhood cancer using interviews, records, exposure measurements and biological samples.
quote: An investigation into the possible causes of childhood cancer has been carried out throughout England, Scotland and Wales over the period 1991-1998.

label: UK Household Longitudinal Study
definition: A cohort of household members across all four United Kingdom nations, interviewed annually in Understanding Society to investigate changes in education, employment, income, health, family life, behaviour and social circumstances.
quote: Data is collected annually from the same households across all four UK nations.
remark: Source is an official methodological working paper.

label: UK Inflammatory Bowel Disease Genetics Consortium
definition: A consortium of inflammatory-bowel-disease patient collections across the United Kingdom combining genetic and clinical data to investigate susceptibility to Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis and variation in treatment response.
quote: building a vast database of genetic and clinical data from patients across the UK
remark: Source is the funder's account of consortium research, not a cohort design paper.

label: Viking Health Study
definition: A cohort of people from the population isolate of Shetland, assembled to identify common and rare genetic variants influencing cardiovascular and other complex-disease risks.
quote: The genetic research cohort study in Shetland was established to identify genetic variants, both common and rare, increasing risk of disease.
remark: Distinguished from the broader VIKING umbrella, which also includes ORCADES.

label: Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium
definition: A consortium of disease-specific case collections and shared controls, coordinated by United Kingdom research groups to identify genetic variants associated with common diseases and evaluate methods for genome-wide association analysis.
quote: GWA studies of 2,000 cases and 3,000 shared controls for 7 complex human diseases

label: Basquecolon cohort
definition: A case-control collection of self-identified non-Hispanic White participants with colorectal cancer and comparison participants, contributing the Basque-colon validation sample for evaluation of polygenic prediction of colorectal cancer risk.
quote: Basque-colon cohort (BCC)
remark: The source names this validation collection and reports participant characteristics in Table 1, but does not establish recruitment location or dates.

label: INTERVAL study
definition: A randomised trial cohort of male and female whole-blood donors recruited during 2012–2014 at NHS Blood and Transplant centres in England to compare donation intervals and assess whether more frequent donation preserves donor health while increasing blood supply.
quote: INTERVAL is a randomised trial of whole blood donors enrolled from all 25 static centres of NHS Blood and Transplant.
remark: INTERVAL is used as the trial name; the protocol supplies no expanded acronym.

label: CONVERGE
definition: A case-control collection of Han Chinese women with recurrent major depression and controls recruited in China to investigate depression genetics through the China, Oxford and Virginia Commonwealth University Experimental Research on Genetic Epidemiology (CONVERGE) consortium.
quote: CONVERGE (China, Oxford and Virginia Commonwealth University Experimental Research on Genetic Epidemiology) consortium recruited 11,670 Han Chinese women
remark: Identifies the Chinese depression collection; CONVERGE has unrelated acronym doubles.

label: Gene-Environmental Interaction and phenotype study
definition: A cohort of Korean participants undergoing comprehensive health examinations at Seoul National University Hospital's Gangnam Center, with linked clinical and biobank data used to investigate genetic and environmental influences on phenotypes.
quote: at the Seoul National University Hospital Healthcare System Gangnam Center, where comprehensive health check-ups and screening are done in Korean populations

label: China Atherosclerosis Study
definition: A case-control collection of Han Chinese people with coronary artery disease and controls in China, assembled for genome-wide identification of coronary-disease susceptibility variants.
quote: CAS consisted of 1,034 cases of CAD and 4,245 controls
remark: Distinct from the Beijing Atherosclerosis Study, listed separately in the same paper.

label: Diabetes Prediction and Prevention
definition: A birth cohort of Finnish children screened from 1994 for HLA-associated type 1 diabetes susceptibility, with genetically at-risk children followed prospectively to investigate islet autoimmunity and diabetes development.
quote: In 1994, an ongoing birth cohort study (Type 1 Diabetes prediction and prevention study [DIPP]) was launched in Finland.

label: Functional genomic diagnostic tools for coronary artery disease
definition: A cohort of patients undergoing coronary angiography at two hospitals in Lebanon, recruited in 2007–2010 for cross-sectional investigation of genetic and clinical factors associated with coronary artery disease.
quote: Patients were recruited at two major hospitals in Lebanon, between May 2007 and June 2010
remark: Proposed type change: temporary unclassified -> cohort. Defined as the FGENTCARD participant collection described by the verified example, rather than the coordinating consortium.

label: German Chronic Kidney Disease Study
definition: A cohort of people under nephrological care across Germany with reduced kidney function or overt proteinuria, followed prospectively with clinical and biological measurements to investigate chronic kidney disease progression, complications and prognostic biomarkers.
quote: The German Chronic Kidney Disease (GCKD) study is a prospective observational national cohort study.

label: German Longevity Study
definition: A case-control collection of German long-lived individuals aged at least 94 years and younger comparison participants, used to investigate genetic contributions to exceptional longevity and reduced susceptibility to age-related diseases.
quote: 1351 German LLI (≥94 years, including 643 centenarians) and 4680 German younger controls.
remark: Age threshold describes the analysed sample in the cited paper.

label: Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events
definition: A registry of patients hospitalised with acute coronary syndromes at centres across multiple countries, followed prospectively during admission and after discharge to compare treatment practices, clinical characteristics and outcomes and improve care.
quote: a large, prospective, multinational observational study of patients hospitalized with ACS.
remark: Proposed type change: cohort aggregation -> cohort. GRACE is a prospectively enrolled patient registry; multicountry participation does not by itself make it a cohort aggregation.

label: TwinGene Study
definition: A cohort of twins from the Swedish Twin Registry undergoing health examinations and venous blood collection in 2004–2008, providing genetic and health data for investigations of ageing, metabolic health and mortality.
quote: TwinGene is a cross-sectional study where participants underwent a health examination and venous blood sample collection
remark: Likely the same participant collection as COHO:0000205 (TwinGene Registry); no distinction is supported by the supplied examples.

label: Uppsala Longitudinal Study of Adult Men
definition: A cohort of men aged about 50 years in Uppsala, Sweden, examined during 1970–1974 and followed prospectively to investigate cardiovascular and lifestyle risk factors, survival and functional independence in old age.
quote: Swedish men investigated in 1970-74 (aged 48.6-51.1) and followed up for four decades
remark: Proposed type change: cohort aggregation -> cohort. The source describes a single longitudinal participant cohort.

label: Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Ageing
definition: A cohort of volunteers participating in the United States National Institute on Aging's longitudinal programme, established in 1958 to investigate individual variation in human ageing and distinguish ageing-related changes from disease processes.
quote: volunteers who made the lifelong commitment to be part of the research
remark: Proposed type change: cohort aggregation -> cohort. The label denotes a longitudinal participant cohort.

label: Motor Neuron Disease Biobank study
definition: A biobank of adults diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis at United Kingdom hospitals, collecting whole-blood DNA from 2004 for genetic research into motor neuron disease.
quote: a national collection of ALS DNA samples derived from whole blood
remark: Proposed type change: cohort aggregation -> cohort. The verified example identifies the UK National DNA Bank for Motor Neuron Disease Research; it denotes a participant/sample collection.

label: Diabetic Cohort
definition: A cohort of adults with type 2 diabetes recruited from public polyclinics and hospital outpatient clinics in Singapore in 2004–2010, followed to investigate genetic, physiological and lifestyle determinants of diabetic complications.
quote: adult participants with type 2 diabetes were recruited from multiple public sector polyclinics and hospital outpatient clinics in Singapore
remark: The generic label resolves to the Singapore Diabetic Cohort (DC), explicitly named in this profile and in the verified example's acknowledgements.

label: Ely Study
definition: A cohort of adults without diabetes aged 40–69 at baseline in Ely, England, followed from 1990 with clinical, anthropometric and biochemical assessments to investigate type 2 diabetes incidence and its relationship to impaired fasting glucose.
quote: Population-based longitudinal study (1990-2000) with clinical, anthropometric and biochemical measurements
remark: The Ely diabetes cohort is distinct from the oncology ELY study.

label: Genetic Asthma Susceptibility to Indoor Pollution in Peru
definition: A case-control collection of children and adolescents aged 9–19 with asthma and without asthma, recruited in two communities of Lima, Peru, in 2011–2014 to investigate genetic and environmental determinants of asthma, immunoglobulin E and lung function.
quote: cases and controls were recruited from two adjacent communities in Lima: Pampas de San Juan de Miraflores and Villa El Salvador

label: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative
definition: A cohort of untreated patients with early Parkinson disease, healthy controls and people without imaging evidence of dopaminergic deficit, enrolled internationally at 24 sites for standardised longitudinal investigation of clinical, imaging, genetic and biospecimen markers of disease progression.
quote: PPMI has detailed the biomarker signature for an early PD cohort defined by clinical features and imaging biomarkers.
remark: Proposed type change: cohort aggregation -> cohort. Defined as the unified observational participant collection, including diagnostic comparison groups.

label: Psychosis Endophenotype Consortium
definition: A consortium of psychosis case, unaffected-relative and control collections from Australia, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain and the United Kingdom that combines genetic data to investigate susceptibility across psychotic disorders, including schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.
quote: These samples were collected through seven centers across Australia and Europe (Germany, Holland, Spain, and United Kingdom).
remark: The consortium is also named Psychosis Endophenotypes International Consortium; the cited paper is the published cohort analysis referenced as in press by the example study.

label: Study of Health in Pomerania
definition: A project combining the SHIP-START and SHIP-TREND population cohorts of adults aged 20–79 in West Pomerania, northeast Germany, recruited in 1997–2001 and 2008–2012 respectively, to investigate health, disease and their determinants through repeated examinations.
quote: comprises the two independent cohorts SHIP-START (recruited between 1997 and 2001) and SHIP-TREND (recruited between 2008 to 2012)
remark: Proposed type change: cohort -> cohort aggregation. The profile explicitly distinguishes the umbrella SHIP project from its original cohort, renamed SHIP-START.

label: The Cooperative Health Research in South Tyrol
definition: A cohort of adults from the middle and upper Vinschgau/Val Venosta in South Tyrol, with family participation, biological samples and repeated follow-up to investigate genetic and molecular determinants of age-related chronic conditions and their interaction with lifestyle and environment.
quote: All adults of the middle and upper Vinschgau/Val Venosta are invited

label: The Health Effects of Arsenic Longitudinal Study
definition: A cohort of adults aged 18–75 from Araihazar, Bangladesh, recruited in 2000–2002 and assessed biennially to investigate health effects of arsenic exposure through drinking water, including chronic disease and mortality.
quote: 11 746 population-based participants (aged 18-75 years) from Araihazar, Bangladesh

label: TwinGene Registry
definition: A cohort of twins from the Swedish Twin Registry undergoing health examinations and venous blood collection in 2004–2008, providing genetic and health data for investigations of ageing, metabolic health and mortality.
quote: between 2004 and 2008
remark: Likely duplicates COHO:0000193 (TwinGene Study). TwinGene is a component of the Swedish Twin Registry, not a separately described registry.
